hs by Trivial.si — local time tracking, tasks, and focus sessions for your terminal, inspired by Project Hamster.

This initial release supports Linux. The prebuilt archive targets **Linux x86-64, glibc 2.35 or newer** and contains `hs`, `LICENSE`, and `NOTICE`. Matching source is available below; other Linux environments can build from source.

Check the archive against `SHA256SUMS`, extract it, and install `hs` somewhere on your PATH. See the README for source installation and first commands. Keep backups of important history and read `docs/hamster.md` before importing a Hamster database.

See `CHANGELOG.md` for features and limitations. Contributions, bug reports, and installation feedback are welcome.
